title: Discovery of anti-inflammatory agents from 3, 4-dihydronaphthalene-1(2H)-one derivatives by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
authors: Li, Wen-Xuan; Yu, Lu; Chi, Jiang-Bo; Wang, Ji-Peng; Liu, Yong-Jun; Wang, Chun-Hua; Zhang, Meng; Hou, Gui-Ge
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物抑制NLRP3炎症小体及NF-kB信号通路，分子对接仅针对蛋白-小分子，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: NLRP3 inflammatory vesicles are a polymer of cellular innate immunity composed of a pair of proteins. The continuous activation of NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammatory vesicles induces the occurrence and enhancement of inflammatory response. In this study, a series of 3, 4-dihydronaphthalene-1(2H)-one derivatives (DHNs, 6a-u, 7a-e, 8a-n) were synthesized and characterized by NMR and HRMS. We evaluated the cytotoxicity and anti-inflammatory activity of all compounds in vitro, and selected 7a substituted by 7-Br in A-ring and 2-pyridylaldehyde in C-ring as effective lead compounds. Specifically, 7a can block the assembly and activation of NLRP3 inflammasome by down-regulating the expression of NLPR3 and apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD (ASC), and inhibiting the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and other inflammatory mediators. In addition, 7a inhibits the phosphorylation of inhibitor kappa B alpha (IkappaBalpha) and NF-kappaB/p65 and the nuclear translocation of p65, thereby inhibiting nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) signaling. Molecular docking analysis confirmed that 7a could reasonably bind the active sites of NLRP3, ASC and p65 proteins. Therefore, 7a is predicted as a potential NLRP3 inflammatory vesicle inhibitor and deserves further research and development.
abstract_zh: NLRP3炎症小体是由一对蛋白质组成的细胞固有免疫聚合体。NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）炎症小体的持续激活诱导炎症反应的发生和增强。本研究合成了一系列3,4-二氢萘-1(2H)-酮衍生物（DHNs, 6a-u, 7a-e, 8a-n），并通过NMR和HRMS进行表征。我们评估了所有化合物在体外的细胞毒性和抗炎活性，并选择在A环上由7-Br取代、C环上由2-吡啶醛取代的7a作为有效先导化合物。具体而言，7a通过下调NLRP3和凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（ASC）的表达，并抑制活性氧（ROS）及其他炎症介质的产生，从而阻断NLRP3炎症小体的组装和激活。此外，7a抑制抑制剂κBα（IkappaBalpha）和NF-kappaB/p65的磷酸化以及p65的核转位，从而抑制核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路。分子对接分析证实，7a能合理结合NLRP3、ASC和p65蛋白的活性位点。因此，7a被预测为潜在的NLRP3炎症小体抑制剂，值得进一步研究和开发。
